title: Intermittent 503s on product pages
alert: Ingress: 5xx ratio for host shop.acme.io /products/* at 7-12% in bursts of 20-60 seconds. Responses are 503 'no healthy upstream'. catalog-service has 0 restarts. Application error logs are noisy.

updates.text: The product launch email goes out in 15 minutes and will roughly triple traffic to /products. We need the 503s stopped before then.
